text:
ashley: Hey all — quick design request for launch comms. Need: one compact decision-flow (for tweet thread + slide), two benchmark variants (simple and detailed), a social hero, and a printable one-pager. Goal: visualize latency vs cost tradeoffs while keeping message friendly to both engineers and SDRs.

mike: Sounds good. Any required dimensions / formats? Also prefer to avoid photographic backgrounds.

ashley: Specs: social hero 1200x675 (for X and LinkedIn preview), webinar slide 16:9 PPTX + PDF, one-pager A4 print-ready, decision-flow 800x1000 PNG + SVG. Name exports like: benchflow_<asset>_v1.png.

zara: Messaging: headline = "Serving that scales: faster, cheaper, reliable". Subhead = "Tradeoffs simplified for product folks and buyers". CTA (webinar) = "Save your seat — Jun 2". Use short bullets for one-pager.

mike: I'll make 3 visual directions: 1) Minimal grid with sparkline icons, 2) Flowchart/decision tree, 3) Radial/soft-gauge showing tradeoffs. Will keep brand colors (blue + charcoal) and avoid high-red.

emily: Legal checks: add the footer line: "Sample outputs are synthetic; do not contain customer data. Actual performance varies." Include this on slide and A4 PDF. Also confirm no comparative claims (e.g., "X% faster than Y") unless sourced.

sam: Ops: tagging to content calendar. We need initial comps in 48 hours to hit promo deadlines. Also require alt text for each export and a 1-sentence summary for localization.

figma-bot: Created file "launch-bench-visuals" and uploaded brand tokens. https://www.figma.com/file/ghijk/launch-bench-visuals?node-id=1%3A2

mike: Export checklist I'll follow (adding notes to frames):
```
- social_1200x675.png (RGB, 72dpi)
- webinar_16x9.pptx (editable PPTX + export PDF)
- onepager_A4_print.pdf (CMYK, 300dpi)
- decisionflow_800x1000.png + decisionflow.svg
```
I'll include alt-text strings in Figma comments and create localized text layers for zh-CN / ja-JP. If translations aren't ready by EOD tomorrow I'll mark text for i18n.

azara: Sample benchmark rows I'll drop into the figma table (illustrative only):
- Fast path: 50ms median / $0.15 per 1k tokens / Quality 8.5/10
- Balanced: 120ms median / $0.06 per 1k tokens / Quality 9.0/10
- Cost-first: 300ms median / $0.02 per 1k tokens / Quality 8.0/10
Keep these labelled "illustrative".

emily: Also request that any alt text avoids proprietary model names. Use neutral wording.

mike: Understood. ETA for first frames: 2 business days. I'll post drafts here and in the Figma file. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Thanks — please add the export filenames and the footnote text to the Figma page. Ping here when assets are uploaded.

figma-bot: Export tokens set for frames: decisionflow_v1, social_v1, slide_v1, onepager_v1.

sam: Noted — setting P1 for decisionflow. We'll route to the launch schedule once assets are final.

mike: Created initial comps and left comments on the social hero re: contrast. Moving to refine accessibility (WCAG AA) now.

azara: I'll prepare short zh-CN and ja-JP strings for headline and CTA by EOD tomorrow.

ashley: Great, thanks everyone.
